headline: Quarterly growth is mixed, with a few firms posting strong revenue gains while others see modest or slowing expansion.
summary: Coforge delivered the fastest top‑line growth at 53.6% YoY and raised its EBIT margin guidance. LTM and HCLTech posted double‑digit growth, driven by AI‑related deals. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook to 1‑2% and saw only 1.5% revenue growth. Wipro’s profit slipped and its guidance signals flat‑to‑slight decline in the next quarter.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure and guidance cuts
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance, while Wipro signaled flat‑to‑slight sequential revenue change.
